children: In a market short on fresh triggers, several stocks quietly grabbed attention on September 8, driven by technical breakouts, strong price action, and sustained buying interest.
The selected stocks are showing strong upward momentum, trading well above their key short- to medium-term moving averages, which indicates a positive trend in the near term.
Garuda Construction shares rose 5.25% to Rs 188.74, trading above all key moving averages and signalling a positive technical trend.
Polysil Irrigation shares climbed 4.25% to Rs 77.50, but remain below their 50-day, 150-day and 200-day moving averages, indicating continued weakness despite the day’s gains.
The selected stocks are witnessing downward pressure, as reflected in negative price movements and their positioning relative to key moving averages, indicating a cautious market sentiment.
Ducol Organics shares fell 6.46% to Rs 101, trading below its 30-day, 50-day, 150-day and 200-day moving averages, indicating a weak technical trend.
Magson Retail shares declined 4.56% to Rs 175.05, falling below its 30-day and 50-day moving averages but remaining above its 150-day and 200-day averages.
SPP Polymer shares dropped 4.29% to Rs 12.05, trading below all four key moving averages, signalling continued technical weakness.
Meanwhile, several stocks touched fresh 52-week high, highlighting persistent buying. Notable names touching new high included TVS Holdings, Solar Industries, Piramal Pharma, Divis Labs.
On the other hand, Voltas, United Breweries, ICICI Lombard, Indiamart Intermesh, JK Lakshmi Cement, IRCTC, Cello World, Dabur India, P&G Hygiene, Godrej Consumer touched 52-week low.
Shanthi Gears, Grand Foundry, Sarveshwar Foods among others were locked in their upper circuits, reflecting strong buying and signalling bullish near-term sentiment.

title: Momentum Stocks: Ducol Organics, Magson Retail, SPP Polymer down 4-6%; Voltas, United Breweries, ICICI Lombard hit 52-week low
